cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(terminal_translation C ASM)
find_package(DynamoRIO REQUIRED)
add_library(terminal_translation_client SHARED client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(terminal_translation_client)
target_compile_options(terminal_translation_client PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
add_executable(terminal_translation_guest guest.c probe.S)
target_compile_options(terminal_translation_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_options(terminal_translation_guest PRIVATE -rdynamic -no-pie)
